patch.summary: Rippling cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Rippling pricing is plan-gated across 2 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Rippling plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Rippling Platform
lines.description: Unlocks: applicant tracking, career site and job boards, interview scheduling · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Payroll / IT / Spend modules
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Rippling cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Rippling against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (applicant tracking, career site and job boards, interview scheduling) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: The list price floor is platform/core only — payroll, IT, spend, and EOR stack PEPM and dominate TCO. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Companies that want HR, payroll, and IT provisioning on one employee record requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: The list price floor is platform/core only — payroll, IT, spend, and EOR stack PEPM and dominate TCO
Side-by-side cost with BambooHR on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: The list price floor is platform/core only — payroll, IT, spend, and EOR stack PEPM and dominate TCO

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: No published free plan or self-serve trial; sales-led packaging

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Easy to overbuy modules that the team will not adopt

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Implementation is non-trivial versus a simple Gusto payroll start

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not a hospitality/frontline WFM specialist (Connecteam/Deputy class)

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Rippling on identical constraints.
